about: Astro AI coding benchmark: small, realistic repository tasks. Each task starts from 'files', the agent gets 'prompt', then the runner copies 'check_files' in (the agent never sees them) and runs 'check' in the folder: exit code 0 = pass.

tasks.prompt: range(a, b) in utils.js should include both ends: range(1, 4) must return [1, 2, 3, 4]. Fix it without changing its signature.
Add a slugify(text) function to strings.js and export it: lowercase, accents removed, runs of anything that is not a-z or 0-9 become a single '-', no leading or trailing '-'. Keep capitalize working.

files.strings.js:
function capitalize(s) { return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1); }
module.exports = { capitalize };

tasks.prompt: fetchAll in loader.js returns an empty array because of how it awaits. Fix it so it returns all results in the input order.
Implement stack.js so that `node test.js` passes. Do not edit test.js.
Rename the function getUsr to getUser everywhere in this project (definition, export and every call). Behaviour must stay the same.

files.users.js:
function getUsr(id) { return { id, name: 'user' + id }; }
module.exports = { getUsr };

check_files..check.js: const a=require('assert');const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['users.js','api.js','main.js'])a.ok(!/getUsr\b/.test(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')),f);a.strictEqual(require('./users').getUser(3).name,'user3');a.strictEqual(require('./api').handler(4),'user4');a.strictEqual(require('child_process').execSync('node main.js').toString().trim(),'user1 2');

tasks.prompt: Add a --verbose flag to cli.js: when present, print 'verbose on' (on its own line) before the normal output. Without the flag the output must not change.

tasks.prompt: In package.json add an npm script named test that runs `node test.js`, and set the version to 1.1.0. Keep everything else as it is.

Create index.html with a form whose id is signup. It needs a required email input named email with a <label> linked to it, a password input named password with minlength 8, and a submit button with the text 'Create account'.
reverse() in strutil.c corrupts strings with an odd length and crashes on empty strings. Fix it. `cc -o t main.c strutil.c && ./t` should print the reversed words.
Write a Makefile so that `make` builds the program hello from hello.c and greet.c, and `make clean` removes the binary and object files.
tasks.check: make clean >/dev/null 2>&1; make >/dev/null && [ "$(./hello)" = "hello make" ] && make clean >/dev/null && [ ! -e hello ] && ! ls *.o >/dev/null 2>&1

tasks.prompt: Write count.sh: `bash count.sh FILE` prints only the number of non-empty lines in FILE (lines with only spaces count as empty). With no argument it prints a usage message to stderr and exits with code 2.
Running `node report.js` crashes. Find out why and fix the bug so it prints the total.
